title: Dean of the Faculty of Russian Philology of BSU took part in the Women's Forum of the ECO-2025

blocks.text: On July 2, 2025, the ECO Women's Forum was held in Lachin (Azerbaijan) on the theme "Strengthening the Role of Women in Building a Sustainable and Climate-Safe Future".

The forum was attended by Rakhat Anarbekovna Niyazalieva, Dean of the Faculty of Russian Philology at BSU, Candidate of Philological Sciences, member of the Board of the Congress of Women of the Kyrgyz Republic.

The Forum has become an important international platform for exchanging experiences, developing strategic approaches and strengthening cooperation between ECO member states for sustainable development.
